task: T2: write docker/loop-executor.Dockerfile. It is modelled on the existing coding-harness-qwen image, minus everything a one-shot executor does not need — no tmux, no gh CLI, no persistent HOME. That reference lives in another repo and is NOT readable from this worktree, so everything you need from it is reproduced here; do not go looking for it. Base on `node:22-bookworm-slim`, install `git`, `ripgrep`, `ca-certificates`, `curl` and `tini` with `--no-install-recommends` and clean the apt lists in the same layer, then install opencode with `npm install -g "opencode-ai@${OPENCODE_VERSION}"` where OPENCODE_VERSION is an `ARG` pinned to 1.17.10. The image MUST build unchanged for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64: do NOT write a `--platform` flag, do NOT use an architecture-qualified base tag, and if any step downloads an architecture-specific artifact resolve the architecture with `dpkg --print-architecture` at build time rather than writing a literal. Give it an ENTRYPOINT through tini that takes the prompt as its argument and runs the executor against `$ROOT`. Do not add a USER line pinning a uid: the binding passes `--user` at run time (spec.md outcome 3), and a baked-in USER would fight it.
